plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Paul Dubov is credited on 159 distinct recordings across 21 programs from 1941-10-20 through 1961-06-18. Documented roles include performer on 159 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 35 recordings; 35 distinct recordings), Gunsmoke (performer on 27 recordings; 27 distinct recordings), The Adventures of Frank Race (performer on 25 recordings; 25 distinct recordings), The Adventures of Philip Marlowe (performer on 13 recordings; 13 distinct recordings), Fort Laramie (performer on 8 recordings; 8 distinct recordings), Have Gun, Will Travel (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), Jeff Regan, Investigator (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), and Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Frank Race (21 portrayals) and Jeff Regan (5 portrayals).
